items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: That was my very, very first band that I played in and I played first trumpet and a little kid named Clarence Trice played second trumpet.

ctx.x: City and organised, his nickname was Mouse because was a little cat he like Mousey Alexander the drummer here, you know, so his name was Mouse Jones, but his real name was Raymond. So he organised a jazz group called, 'Mouse and his Music'. (LAUGHTER).
That was my very, very first band that I played in and I played first trumpet and a little kid named Clarence Trice played second trumpet.
